descricao_original: The lining of the esophageal mucosa is typical stratified squamous moist epithelium, providing protection for the esophagus as well as forming a barrier to microbes. Because nucleated cells remain at the surface of this epithelium, the epithelium is classified as non-keratinized. 200x
